outcome: maternal outcomes (cesarean section rate, caesarean hysterectomy, massive blood transfusion)
perinatal outcomes (live births, intrauterine death, NICU admissions)
cohort: Pregnant women who presented with Antepartum Hemorrhage (APH) at a tertiary care centre.
finding: The incidence of antepartum hemorrhage was 1.16%, primarily affecting multiparous women aged 26-30 years, and it was associated with high rates of maternal and perinatal morbidity and mortality.
mod_finding: An overall increased rate of cesarean sections (95%) was observed, with 5% of abruptio placenta and 8.69% of placenta previa cases undergoing cesarean hysterectomy.
gest_age: Most cases presented after 37 weeks of gestation.
